description: This file defines utility functions for file reading, property extraction from configuration files, file existence checks, recursive file searches, and string property expansion. It contains functions like 'readPropertyFromFile', 'readFileContent', 'isRegularFile', 'searchFilesRec', 'searchFiles', and 'ExpandPropertiesInString', all encapsulated within the 'Utils' namespace.

methods.name: bool readPropertyFromFile(const char * filename,const string & property,string & propertyValue)
methods.description: Reads a property value from a configuration file based on the property name, with support for recursive expansion if the value starts with '$'.

methods.name: bool readFileContent(const char * filename,string & content)
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a file into a string.

methods.name: bool isRegularFile(const string & path)
methods.description: Checks whether a given path corresponds to a regular file.

methods.name: bool searchFilesRec(std::vector<std::string> & pathList,unsigned int currentDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Recursively searches for files matching patterns in given directories, with support for exclusions and result cap.

methods.name: bool searchFiles(string & inputPath,int maxDepth,int minDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Entry point for recursive file search, initiating the process based on input path and exclusions.

methods.name: bool ExpandPropertiesInString(const char * input,const char * filePath,string & expandedString)
methods.description: Replaces occurrences of variables in a string with corresponding property values read from a file.
